svg.title: Before: scattered, contradictory config. After: one pipeline, one source of truth
svg.desc: Before: agents in ~/.claude/agents/ (planner.md next to planner-actually-good.md, written at 2 AM), commands in .claude/commands/, rule files that contradict each other and a session snapshot saved months ago: 6 agents, 4 commands, 3 rule files. You can't remember which is current. Neither can Claude. After: one pipeline, brainstorm, story, plan, build, review, ship, with debug looping under build. 10 skills · 6 agents · 2 hooks · 1 workflow, installed with claude plugin install turbocharge@turbocharge. One source of truth.

text.font-family: 'Space Mono Bold', 'Space Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: FROM SCATTERED CONFIG TO ONE PIPELINE.
